title: Vivacious
summary: VIVA'CIOUS, adjective [Latin vivax, from vivo, to live.] 1. Lively; active; sprightly in temper or conduct. 2. Long lived. [Not in use.] 3. Having vigorous powers of life; as vivacious plants.
